title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 experts: home (3.25 bpw) at TP=4 and TP=6, bit225 (2.25 bpw) at TP=3
summary: Full GLM 5.3 on g6, a from-scratch CUDA engine with no vLLM, PyTorch or NCCL at serve time. Up to 8 requests decode at once, with DFlash2 or MTP drafting chosen each round at TP=4, prefix reuse, and context-parallel KV. Boots from one Hugging Face release.

configs.label: TP=4
configs.notes: RigMark 1.0.0, reasoning_effort low, GPU clocks capped at 2200 MHz, booted from the Hugging Face release. Code varies between boots (41.5 to 49.3 on one build). Structured output is not reported: it measures predictable output, not agent speed.

configs.label: TP=3
configs.notes: bit225 experts (about 2.25 bpw), MTP only. Mean of two boots. RigMark 1.0.0, reasoning_effort low, GPU clocks capped at 2200 MHz, booted from the Hugging Face release.

configs.label: TP=6
configs.notes: Served through S2, MTP only. GPU clocks uncapped (about 2450 to 2550 MHz), not the 2200 MHz cap of the other configs. Decode is a concurrency test with code prompts, MTP k=2 at temperature 0.7, one request alone and 2 and 4 at once; not RigMark. One test window on one cluster.
